rationale: Figma centers on collaborative interface/product design and prototyping, while Airtable centers on structured records, configurable apps, and operational workflows. They can be used together, but their primary jobs differ.

Airtable is a flexible database and workflow-app platform; HubSpot is a CRM and marketing/sales platform. Some teams can build customer trackers in Airtable, but the products are not direct substitutes for their core offerings.

Salesforce provides a broad CRM and customer platform, while Zendesk is centered on customer service and support operations. Service-product overlap exists, but their overall primary jobs differ under a strict same-primary-problem label rule.

Wrike focuses on project/work management, tasks, and delivery tracking; Miro focuses on a visual collaboration canvas for workshops and diagrams. Teams may use both in the same workflow rather than substitute one for the other.
HubSpot is a CRM and marketing/sales platform, whereas Vercel is web application deployment and frontend cloud infrastructure. They address unrelated primary problems and can be complementary tools.
Salesforce centers on CRM and customer operations, while Sentry provides application error/performance monitoring for software teams. Their primary jobs are distinct.
